findings.span: Can strongly inhibit tyrosinase activity, reducing hyperpigmentation
findings.why: Claims the product acts on an enzyme in the melanin pathway and strongly so; this is a body-function claim and the ingredient-level data is not this product's test.
findings.fix: Butylresorcinol: an active used for the look of hyperpigmentation

tone_read: Calm, declarative and education-led, in line with Minimalist voice; no fear, hype or urgency pressure.
language_read: Actives and strengths are named as on the product page and the rating carries its source and capture date.
